jobs.title: Lead User Experience Researcher
jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 11/23/2026Meet the Team
  
Cisco Cloud Control is a unified operations platform designed for AgenticOps, which brings every Cisco domain—including networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration—into one consistent environment. It enables IT teams to proactively manage, govern, and operate their full IT estate from a single experience without replacing existing individual product dashboards.
  
  
**A key part of this role will be platform measurement:** defining, baselining, and tracking the UX metrics that tell us whether our most important Cisco Cloud Control platform journeys are delivering on customer outcomes. This is a quantitative-research heavy role. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Design, Data Science and Engineering to translate ambiguous questions into measurement plans, consume and interpret quantitative data (telemetry, surveys, benchmarks), and know when a number needs a human story behind it — flagging where qualitative follow-up is needed to explain what the data can't.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As a Lead UX Researcher, you’ll be part of the AI Software& Platform Team, working on Cisco Cloud Control, AI Canvas, Studio and Marketplace. In this role, you’ll drive a deep understanding of users to shape the future of Cisco’s user experiences across the platform and its AI-powered solutions. You will also:
  
  

* Define and track key UX success metrics across priority platform journeys, in partnership with Product Management, Design, Data Science and Engineering
* Build and maintain measurement plans; align partners on what's being measured, why, and how success is defined
* Baseline platform journey quality and track over time
* Analyze and communicate quantitative findings to partners in terms they can act on
* Identify where quantitative signals are inconclusive or surprising, and scope qualitative research to explain the"wh" behind the data
* Work cross-functionally across business units, connecting measurement findings across the broader platform
* Design, execute, and analyze quantitative studies (large-scale surveys like SUS/CSAT/SEQ, benchmark studies, A/B tests) and qualitative studies (interviews, concept evaluations)

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors + 8 years of related experience, or Masters + 6 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience, or equivalent related work experience
* 7+ years leading end-to-end quantitative and qualitative UX research (discovery, planning, recruitment, execution, synthesis, analysis, presentation), ideally applying AI to augment and accelerate your research craft
* Experience partnering with Product, Design, Data Science and Engineering teams to define and execute user-centered success measures and measurement plans
* Experience using quantitative research skills e.g. surveys (SUS, CSAT, NPS, SEQ), statistical analysis, benchmarking, A/B and multivariant testing
* Experience with qualitative research e.g. user interviews, moderated and/or unmoderated usability testing, concept evaluations, journey mapping
* Experienceapplying AI to augment and accelerate your research craft

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with Amplitude or other equivalent platforms
* Experience conducting research on AI software or related topics
* Ability to translate behavioral data into clear, decision-ready narratives
* Demonstrated experience building and owning UX measurement frameworks or success-metric programs, not just single studies
* Comfort working directly with product telemetry/instrumentation data
* Can easily navigate and bring clarity to ambiguity
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Curiosity and confidence to ask questions that will uncover stakeholders’ true research needs
* Ability to challenge traditional assumptions about UX research – inventing, testing and sharing new approaches
* Experience in a B2B large enterprise environment a bonus

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:
Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier life for all. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations. Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions. Our management philosophy, "Jeong-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer-Value Creation' and 'People-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment. Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology. At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone.

**The Opportunity**

**About the Team – LG's Emerging Technology Lab**

LG's Emerging Technology Lab (ETL) is the catalyst for technological innovation within LG's CTO organization. Based in Silicon Valley and New Jersey, we drive excellence across the CTO organization and LG's business units by pioneering select emerging technology areas. As a Center of Excellence (CoE), we define and shape key technology domains, setting strategic directions that foster impactful internal and external partnerships and deliver measurable business value.

**About the Position – Physical AI Lead**

We are seeking an exceptional Physical AI researcher to help define the future of embodied intelligence at LG and shape our research and product roadmaps toward the vision of *Zero-Labor Home*.

This hybrid role, based at LG's Emerging Tech Lab in **Santa Clara, CA**, offers a unique opportunity to **develop generalist robot intelligence and deploy it at scale** in next-generation LG robot platforms. You will work at the frontier of embodied intelligence, leading research that can transition from breakthrough ideas to real-world products at global scale.

You will lead a growing team of Physical AI researchers and work closely with robotics and AI teams across LG to translate cutting-edge research into next-generation intelligent systems.

**What You Will Do**

* **Set the technical direction for LG's Physical AI team**, leading advanced research in multimodal robot foundation models and physical intelligence.
* Lead and manage **collaborations with LG HQ and third-party research labs** to drive the technical integration of advanced robotics technologies into the LG ecosystem.
* **Build and influence a cross-functional Physical AI ecosystem**, partnering with LG's AI, robotics, software, and product teams as well as leading external research partners.
* Define **project scope, goals, and deliverables** that align cutting-edge research with strategic business objectives.
* **Lead fundamental and applied research** that advances the scientific and technological frontiers of physical intelligence, with a clear path toward real-world robotic systems.
* **Invent and improve paradigms for physical intelligence**, including multimodal foundation models (images, video, text, tactile, etc.), world-action models, generalist dexterity, and agentic robot orchestration.

**Why This Opportunity Is Unique**

* **See your research move beyond the lab.** Work at the intersection of frontier AI research and large-scale consumer deployment, where breakthroughs can transition rapidly from research into products.
* **Maintain a strong research presence while building real products**, with support for research ownership, publication, and collaboration with leading universities and AI labs.
* **Engage with startups and industry collaborators** to co-design hardware-software systems and validate them in real-world applications.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, with a strong publication record and 3+ years of industry experience.
* Deep research and engineering expertise in one or more of the following areas:
* + Robot foundation models (e.g., VLAs, LBMs, diffusion/flow matching policies for manipulation and locomotion)
  + World model training for robot action prediction
  + Spatial intelligence (self-supervised visual foundation models, 3D scene reconstruction, embodied scene understanding)
  + Multimodal representation learning across vision, language, and touch
  + Learning from human demonstrations and self-play
* 1+ years of experience leading technically ambitious research projects in dynamic, fast-moving environments.
* Hands-on experience integrating AI models with real robotic systems, including manipulators and/or mobile robots, and sensors such as RGB and depth cameras, LiDAR, force-torque sensors, and tactile sensors.
* Experience with physics-based simulation platforms (e.g., PyBullet, MuJoCo, Isaac Sim) for large-scale data generation, experimentation, and evaluation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical ideas across research, engineering, and leadership teams.

jobs.title: Sr. Conversational AI Product Design Technologist , Prime Video
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Do you want to shape the next generation of the Amazon Prime Video's content discovery and viewing experience? Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies and TV. From one service, we're delivering versatile ways to watch hundreds of thousands of movies, TV series, and live events on the web, mobile, and TV. Our service is available in more than 200 territories globally, and we're just getting started.  
  
Working closely with business and technology partners, we use research, design, and prototyping to explore the frontier of generative AI and conversational experiences, guide early product development, and develop a customer-centric point of view.  
  
As a Conversational AI Product Design Technologist, you'll be a key part of our UX design organization. Your role will be all about proving, advancing, and evolving cutting-edge conversational experiences through prototyping and hands-on product work. You'll translate human conversational needs into AI interaction behaviors, and you'll build what you design, writing system instructions, shaping model behavior, building evaluations, and prototyping across platforms. We welcome candidates who come at this from design technology, UX research, linguistics, or IVR backgrounds, and we value a deep instinct for conversation paired with real AI fluency.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Build high-quality, functional prototypes that convey and advance the vision of future conversational experiences.

  

* Translate human conversational needs into AI interaction behaviors, balancing a natural and trustworthy voice.

  

* Shape model behavior by writing and refining system instructions and prompts, building goldens and platinums, and partnering on reinforcement learning and evaluations.

  

* Design and build for repair and recovery, handling ambiguity, misunderstanding, hallucination, and graceful failure.

  
-Define conversational quality metrics and apply them to measurably improve the experience, including building LLM-as-a-judge evaluations.  
  

* Prototype across voice, text, visual, and ambient (multimodal) surfaces, using the best and most appropriate tools for the task.

  

* Collaborate with design leadership and stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle, and work alongside designers, researchers, PMs, and engineers to drive concepts from idea to implementation.

  

* Thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment with ambiguous challenges and brand new customer experiences.

  
A day in the life  
One moment you might be mapping how a conversation should recover when a customer is misunderstood, then writing the system instructions that get the model there and standing up an evaluation to measure whether it holds up. The next moment, you might be building an interactive prototype on AWS Bedrock to show partners and leadership what the experience feels like, directing the model the way a film director uses analogies rather than spot correcting, letting it apply its own reasoning and world knowledge to interpret intent. You will move fluidly between designing the experience, shaping the model, and coding the prototype that makes it real.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of front-end technologist, engineer, or UX prototyper experience
* An available online portfolio, with coding or prototyping samples that demonstrate conversational AI work.
* Hands-on experience prototyping with and designing for LLM-powered products.
* Experience shaping AI systems, including writing system instructions and prompts and building or running evaluations.
* Experience building functional prototypes, for example with front-end technologies, AI prototyping tools, or AWS tools such as Bedrock.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Background in UX Design, UX research, linguistics, computational linguistics, or IVR/voice design.

- Experience defining conversational quality metrics and running LLM evaluations, including LLM-as-a-judge.  

* Experience prototyping multimodal experiences across voice, text, visual, and ambient surfaces.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, model shaping, reinforcement learning, and AI-driven personalization.
* Understanding of WCAG AA standards and accessibility fluency.
* Expertise in working creatively around constraints and navigating ambiguous projects.
* Experience in entertainment, gaming, or streaming media.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in design, HCI, computer science, linguistics, or equivalent.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

Outset builds digital twins: AI systems that represent specific real people and respond to research questions the way those people would. The Digital Twins Team runs an ongoing research program to measure and improve how faithfully these systems reproduce human responses and behavior, across a range of cross-sectional levels of analysis.

The Research Engineer reports to the Head Scientist and builds and maintains the systems that let the team's scientists run their studies correctly, reproducibly, and at scale. The scientists design the studies and define the measurements; you make sure every experiment executes exactly as designed, that results can be reproduced from stored inputs, and that research code stays in step with the shipped product. The ideal candidate has supported scientists in an academic computational social science lab or a comparable research setting and has hands-on experience engineering systems built on large language models.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the evaluation infrastructure that tests competing modeling approaches, so that new tests can be set up quickly, run concurrently and automatically, and be monitored.
* Implement measurement pipelines exactly as specified by the scientists, with deterministic and traceable outputs.
* Maintain versioned evaluation datasets with held-out sets that are never used for training.
* Build and maintain data pipelines for human-participant data, external datasets, and model training data, including linkage of records belonging to the same participant across sources.
* Keep research code in step with the production product so that validated improvements ship promptly.
* Detect and prevent threats to the validity of evaluations.
* Track compute and API spend across experiments and their implications for production-stage costs
* Manage repositories, code review, documentation, and the reproducibility of the team's coding workflow.
* Identify implementation choices that can be made more correct or more efficient, and propose changes.

**Qualifications**

* Several years of software engineering experience, including experience supporting researchers in a lab or comparable setting.
* Experience translating specific scientific requirements and experiment designs into code.
* Experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines on human behavior data, and confirming that the pipelines matched the criteria and design the researchers specified.
* Strong Python, including the ability to read and audit code produced by agentic coding tools.
* Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, tabular data, and Git-based workflows.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and with running many jobs concurrently.
* Working understanding of machine learning, including how transformer-based language models behave, how model APIs are used, and what fine-tuning involves.
* A habit of writing deterministic, reproducible, cost-aware, and well-documented code.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Hands-on experience engineering large language model systems: prompt pipelines, evaluation harnesses, embedding computation, agentic systems, and/or fine-tuning infrastructure.
* Experience fine-tuning open-weight language models on multi-GPU hardware.
* Experience serving open-weight models with an inference framework such as vLLM or SGLang, including batched inference and prefix caching for many requests that share a common prompt.
* Experience with experiment tracking and cost monitoring for machine learning workloads.
* Experience with survey or panel data and data collection platforms.
* Experience extracting and storing model activations for downstream analysis.
* Experience with experiment tracking and cost monitoring for machine learning workloads, including GPU provisioning across cloud providers.
* Prior work on generative agents, digital twins, or simulation of human respondents.

Compensation Range: $200K - $240K

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The Research Scientist works directly with and reports to the Head Scientist. Together you will choose what to study, design the studies, define how results are measured, interpret the findings, and write them up for internal decision-making and, where appropriate, for academic publication. You will bring current methodological training in computational social science, data science, survey-methodology, human-computation interaction, and experiment design.

**Responsibilities**

* Co-design and run studies that compare system-generated responses with responses from humans, using both qualitative and quantitative measures.
* Design, justify, and hone measures of performance.
* Apply and adapt state-of-the-art statistical techniques common to survey methodology and large-scale social data analysis, to benchmark and improve sample- and population-level simulation performance.
* Design evaluations and experiments with pre-specified analysis plans.
* Design and oversee human rating studies, including rater training, coding rubrics, and inter-rater agreement measurement.
* Design data collection from third-party data sources and directly from human participants, including longitudinal and repeated-measures studies.
* Contribute to the research agenda for new modeling approaches, including evaluation of fine-tuned models and of model calibration.
* Specify analyses precisely enough for an engineer to implement.
* Co-author papers, preprints, and presentations.

**Qualifications**

* A completed or nearly completed PhD in computational social science, communication, HCI, sociology, political science, psychology, statistics, or a related field.
* Peer-reviewed publications on which you were a primary author.
* Working command of graduate-level statistical methodology common to social science, including the assumptions behind each.
* Experience analyzing large-scale telemetry and behavioral datasets, with attention to the validity of the resulting inference.
* Familiarity with machine learning, spanning classical, nonparametric, and LLM-based approaches, including how transformer-based language models work, what fine-tuning does, and how the major model families differ.
* Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, and tabular data.
* Ability to work in an environment where most code is produced through agentic coding tools, and to read and check that code.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience fine-tuning open-weight language models on survey, experimental, or behavioral data.
* Experience building or evaluating calibrated confidence or error-prediction models, including deriving decision thresholds from human judgments.
* Experience measuring similarity of open-ended text, for example with embedding-based methods.
* Experience designing or running panel-based data collection with human participants.
* Experience presenting research at academic and/or industry conferences.
* Prior work on generative agents, digital twins, or simulation of human respondents.
* Familiarity with the startup ecosystem
* Familiarity with qualitative interviews and ethnographic methods
* Familiarity with topics in computational linguistics

Compensation Range: $200K - $240K

* Support programs performing research and product development encompassing multiple engineering disciplines including mechanical, electrical, optics, and controls engineering.
* Project support includes design and development of advanced quantum-sensing-based guidance and navigation algorithms; design and development of advanced pointing and stabilization systems for spacecraft, payloads, and next generation large segmented optical telescopes; design and development of controls test beds and related facilities to demonstrate pointing and stabilization system performance, and control system synthesis and analysis.

  
The ideal candidate will have familiarity with the control of high-bandwidth precision mechanisms through design and test, understand space environments, and work well in a dynamic multi-disciplinary environment.

**The ideal candidate will have a PhD in aerospace or mechanical engineering with at least 10 years of professional experience.** Candidate must be a US Person (US Citizen or Green Card holder).

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience (industry or internships) in building world models for adaptive systems, foundation models, continuous dynamical systems, state-space models, and deep generative architectures.
* Experience with model robustness, out-of-distribution generalization, and uncertainty quantification.
* Research experience with first-author publications at machine learning venues or domain journals (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong experience learning underlying system dynamics from partially observable environments, managing irregular sampling, missing modalities, and latent state estimation.
* Experience applying these methodologies to biomedical domains, framing multi-modal healthcare data, longitudinal EHRs (e.g., MIMIC-IV), and physiological telemetry as complex adaptive systems.
* Proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (JAX, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).
* Strong collaborative skills for working in interdisciplinary teams alongside clinical partners.
* Passion for AI technology and all of its possibilities.

**About the job**
-----------------

As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Frontier Health is developing foundational biomedical intelligence to transform outcomes for complex systemic diseases. We build physiological world models and agentic decision systems that simulate disease advancement and treatment responses across critical care, oncology, and metabolic health. By bridging multi-modal telemetry, EHR data, and reinforcement learning, we are shifting healthcare from reactive observation to proactive intervention.  
  
As a Research Scientist, you will advance foundational models for human biology. You will manage problems spanning continuous dynamical systems and counterfactual reasoning to decode pathophysiology.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Conduct fundamental and applied ML research to develop physiological and behavioral world models simulating continuous-time human biology.
* Design novel machine learning architectures (e.g., state-space models, neural dynamical systems) for multi-modal clinical telemetry and longitudinal EHRs (e.g., MIMIC-IV).
* Build and maintain robust evaluation benchmarks (OxyBench) to assess disease trajectory predictions, acute clinical events (e.g., sepsis), and counterfactual treatment simulations.
